messages:
alex: FYI we just got customer reports of billing vs console mismatch after enabling stricter fncall validation in a canary. opening thread.

sara: what mismatch exactly?

alex: console shows a large uptick in degen route usage (cheap model) but billing shows heavy-model token charges. preliminary logs show validator rejected because of unexpected enum member; router fallbacked to degen, but meter events kept the original route tag.

maria: can you paste an example? anonymized is fine.

alex: example: REQUEST has "tool":"translate", metadata.route=route_prod_eu, and an extra enum value in args causing validator reject(mode=strict). Router sets final_route=route_degen_eu, but meter emitted with route_prod_eu earlier.

jamal: so meter prefers initial tag and never reconciled after the swap. we should always annotate final_route before billing emission.

ops-bot: alert: validation-fallback spike 2026-03-05T14:02:10Z (eu region).

sara: immediate plan: 1) hotfix router to annotate meter envelope with final_route before any downstream emission, 2) add route_swap_events metric, 3) backfill affected window for billing audit.

maria: long-term: formalize contract: validator -> emits validation_decision event with effective_route_hint; router -> guarantees final_route on all telemetry; meter -> authoritative source is final_route if present. Add unit/integration tests.

jamal: UX ask: in Console rollout controls, simulate strictness change and show expected fallback% and estimated billing delta. That would have prevented surprise.

alex: rolling router hotfix to canary now. will post deploy note.

ops-bot: deploy-note: alex/router-annotate-final-route -> canary @6632109888.

sara: once hotfix is stable, run backfill job and publish job id. customers will need reconciled numbers.

alex: scheduled backfill job id job-20260305-translate-01. will report progress.

maria: also add a dashboard tile comparing meter vs billing counts per route for last 24h so we can catch regression quickly.

alex: agreed. leaving thread open for updates.
